Naan Baker's Percentage

Naan is mixed from 400 g of flour at 65% water, no starter, 1.8% salt, and 0.8% yeast. Cook it on a hot dry pan until it blisters.

Percentages are of the flour you weigh out, and effective hydration also counts the flour and water inside a starter that is itself 100% hydration.
